facts.fact: NIA Executive Director Wisdom Yayra Koku told Metro TV on 17 September 2025 that NIA cleared a 640,000-card backlog by printing at its district offices, using 700,000 blank cards released by its private partner Identity Management Systems after negotiation.

GHA.note: No register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Only card printing is described; no biometric check or certification.
